sections.title: Habit and habitat
sections.text: Brachycereus nesioticus is a cactus endemic to the Galápagos and a pioneer of recent lava fields. Its upright, ribbed, spiny stems are usually 10–50 cm tall and form cushions up to about 2 m across. The flowers are yellow and the rounded reddish-brown fruit is spiny.

sections.title: Plate and food
sections.text: The plate accurately shows the spiny stems and characteristic yellow flowers. No reliable human food use was verified for this species.
